Hospitals,
Dispensaries and
Other Establishment
(State Scheme)
column7:
Reduction in provision of
₹1,704.38 lakh was the
net effect of increase of
₹1,897.81 lakh, decrease
by re-appropriation of
₹2,100.31 lakh and
surrender of ₹1,501.88
lakh. Increase was
attributed to publication
& printing, conference
workshop, seminar
advertisement &
publication, machine &
equipment. Decrease by
re-appropriation and
surrender were attributed
to anticipated saving.
Final saving of ₹3,128.05
lakh is understated by
₹1.77 lakh due to
clearance of OB suspense
related to previous years.
Reasons for actual final
saving of ₹3,129.82 lakh
have not been intimated
(July 2025).
